#include <iostream>
#include <fstream>
#include <sstream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

class Reader {
private:
    istream* is;
    string line;
    istringstream iss;
    bool useFile;
public:
    Reader() : is(&cin), useFile(false) {}
    Reader(const string& filename) {
        ifstream* file = new ifstream(filename);
        if (file->is_open()) {
            is = file;
            useFile = true;
        } else {
            delete file;
            is = &cin;
            useFile = false;
        }
    }
    ~Reader() {
        if (useFile) delete is;
    }
    string next() {
        while (getline(*is, line)) {
            if (!line.empty()) {
                iss.clear();
                iss.str(line);
                string token;
                if (iss >> token) return token;
            }
        }
        return "";
    }
    int nextInt() {
        string token = next();
        return stoi(token);
    }
};

class Task {
public:
    void go() {
        int t = 1;
        while (t > 0) {
            solve();
            t--;
        }
        out.flush();
        if (outputFile) outFile.close();
    }

    Task() : mod(1000000007), inf(2000000000), eps(0.000000001) {
        // Try to open output.txt
        outFile.open("output.txt");
        if (outFile.is_open()) {
            out.rdbuf(outFile.rdbuf());
            outputFile = true;
        } else {
            out.rdbuf(cout.rdbuf());
            outputFile = false;
        }

        // Reader is initialized based on input file availability
        ifstream testIn("input.txt");
        if (testIn.is_open()) {
            testIn.close();
            in = new Reader("input.txt");
        } else {
            in = new Reader();
        }
    }

    ~Task() {
        delete in;
    }

private:
    int mod;
    int inf;
    double eps;
    Reader* in;
    ostringstream out;
    ofstream outFile;
    bool outputFile;

    void solve() {
        int n = in->nextInt();
        vector<vector<int>> dp(2 * n, vector<int>(n + 1, 0));
        dp[0][1] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < 2 * n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                if (j + 1 <= n) {
                    dp[i][j + 1] = (dp[i][j + 1] + dp[i - 1][j]) % mod;
                }
                if (j - 1 >= 0) {
                    dp[i][j - 1] = (dp[i][j - 1] + dp[i - 1][j]) % mod;
                }
            }
        }

        int ans = 0;
        for (int i = 2 * n - 2; i >= 0; i -= 2) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                if (j <= 2 * n - 1 - i && j % 2 == 1) {
                    ans = (ans + dp[i][j]) % mod;
                }
            }
        }
        out << ans;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    Task task;
    task.go();
    return 0;
}
